therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Antibody-drug conjugate targeting CD19 combined with BTK kinase inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: B-cell lymphoma cell killing via CD19-targeted cytotoxin delivery and B-cell receptor pathway inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma and Mantle Cell Lymphoma patients
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Phase 1: Safety (TEAEs, DLTs); Phase 2: Complete Response Rate

results.target_engagement_evidence: PK data showed dose-proportional exposure for loncastuximab tesirine components (total antibody, PBD-conjugated antibody, unconjugated cytotoxin)
biomarker_changes: Anti-drug antibody development was rare (1 participant in Phase 1)
subgroup_findings: MCL showed higher complete response rate (90%) compared to DLBCL subtypes (~27%)
Similar efficacy between GCB and non-GCB DLBCL subtypes
safety_signals: Dose-limiting toxicities at 90 µg/kg dose (2/6 participants)
Serious adverse events included neutropenia, febrile neutropenia, atrial fibrillation, cardiac events
results.dose_information: Loncastuximab tesirine: 60, 75, or 90 µg/kg IV; Ibrutinib: oral capsule; 90 µg/kg showed DLTs
